metadata.question: Does the forest fire burn over 0.8 million hectares of land in Quebec, Canada in 2023?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use MODIS Burned Area MCD64A1 v6.1 (MODIS/061/MCD64A1), fallback to v6.0 if empty.
- Location: Quebec province polygon from FAO GAUL level1 for Canada (ADM1_NAME 'Québec' or 'Quebec').
- Time: 2023-01-01 to 2024-01-01 (full year 2023).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Cloud masking not needed; use burned area product.
- Build annual burned mask by OR-ing (max) monthly burned masks (BurnDate > 0).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size = 0 after fallback => C1.
- If coverage pixel count within region = 0 => C2.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN => C3.
- Otherwise, compute burned area; if > 800,000 ha => A, else B.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2023-01-01';
    const end = '2024-01-01';
    const adminL1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Québec'),
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Quebec')
      ));
    const fcCount = await getInfoAsync(adminL1.size());
    if (!fcCount || fcCount === 0) {
      console.log('Region lookup failed: GAUL L1 Quebec not found.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const region = adminL1.geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (with fallback)
    let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region);
    let colSize = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (colSize === 0) {
      datasetId = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region);
      colSize = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId} (2023), Images: ${colSize}`);
    if (colSize === 0) {
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const burnedMasks = col.map(img => img.select('BurnDate').gt(0).rename('burned').selfMask());
    const burnedAnnual = burnedMasks.max().rename('burned');

    // Coverage (any data for BurnDate in 2023)
    const coverage = ee.Image(1).updateMask(col.select('BurnDate').max().mask()).rename('coverage');

    const scale = 1000;
    const covDict = await getInfoAsync(coverage.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
    }));
    const coverageCount = covDict ? covDict.coverage : null;
    console.log(`Coverage pixels (@${scale} m): ${coverageCount}`);
    if (coverageCount === null || coverageCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    const burnCountDict = await getInfoAsync(burnedAnnual.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
    }));
    const burnedPixelCount = burnCountDict ? burnCountDict.burned : 0;

    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('px_area').updateMask(burnedAnnual);
    const areaDict = await getInfoAsync(areaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e12,
    }));
    const area_m2 = areaDict ? areaDict.px_area : null;
    if (area_m2 === null || isNaN(area_m2)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    const area_ha = area_m2 / 1e4;
    const area_Mha = area_ha / 1e6;

    // 4. Output concise stats
    console.log(`Region: Quebec, Canada (GAUL L1), Features: ${fcCount}`);
    console.log(`Burned pixels: ${burnedPixelCount}`);
    console.log(`Burned area: ${area_ha.toFixed(0)} ha (${area_Mha.toFixed(3)} Mha)`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const thresholdHa = 800000; // 0.8 Mha
    const exceeded = area_ha > thresholdHa;
    console.log(`Threshold 800000 ha exceeded: ${exceeded}`);
    if (exceeded) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
